status_meanings.not-reviewed: A review is required; no compliance assertion.
status_meanings.pending-fix: A previously identified issue is addressed by a separate open PR; unverified until it merges and tests pass.
status_meanings.reviewed: A human checked the guideline and attached evidence; still subject to future upstream changes.
